context: Tests whether the agent correctly implements the sync library installation check, uses the exact prescribed download URL and user-space install path, runs the sync with the required output flag, and captures both stdout and exit code as specified in the skill.

checklist.name: Existence check before install
checklist.description: Script checks whether $HOME/.tripit-reclaim/sync.mjs exists before attempting installation

checklist.name: Correct download URL
checklist.description: Installation uses the exact GitHub tarball URL for the pinned version: https://github.com/jbaruch/reclaim-tripit-timezones-sync/archive/refs/tags/v0.3.0.tar.gz

checklist.name: User-space install path
checklist.description: Downloaded archive is extracted to $HOME/.tripit-reclaim (user-space, not /opt/ or other system paths)

checklist.name: npm ci with --omit=dev
checklist.description: Dependencies are installed using `npm ci --omit=dev` (not `npm install` or `npm ci` without --omit=dev)

checklist.name: Post-install verification
checklist.description: After the download and npm ci steps complete, the script verifies sync.mjs exists before proceeding to run it (a separate check from the initial existence check — this catches download/extract failures)

checklist.name: Install failure aborts
checklist.description: Script exits with non-zero code if sync.mjs does not exist after install attempt (does not silently continue to the sync step)

checklist.name: Correct sync command
checklist.description: Sync is run with sync subcommand and --output=json flag (not dry-run)

checklist.name: JSON output captured to file
checklist.description: Script captures stdout from the sync command and writes it to sync-output.json

checklist.name: Exit code propagation
checklist.description: Script captures the sync command's exit code and uses it to determine its own exit code

checklist.name: Non-zero exit on sync failure
checklist.description: Script exits with non-zero code when the sync command fails (exit code 1)
